buildCmd: mkdir -p app/renderer/dist/assets/fonts && cp app/renderer/src/assets/fonts/*.woff2 app/renderer/dist/assets/fonts/ && node .ds-sync/node_modules/@tailwindcss/cli/dist/index.mjs -i .design-sync/ds-styles.src.css -o app/renderer/dist/ds-styles.css

dtsPropsFor.AgentRoleDot:
/** Agent type / subagent role. Colours the dot by type family. Renders neutral grey when null. */
  role: string | null;
dtsPropsFor.AgentTypeLabel:
/** Agent type / subagent role. Renders the normalized display label in mono, toned by type. Renders nothing when null or empty. */
  role: string | null;
dtsPropsFor.AgentTypeChip:
/** Agent type / subagent role. Renders a soft-tinted uppercase pill. An unrecognised role still gets a neutral chip; only null or empty renders nothing. */
  role: string | null;
dtsPropsFor.AgentStateWord:
/** Lifecycle state. Renders the COMPRESSED word for crowded rows (running / needs input / done / failed), toned by the same vocabulary AgentStateLabel uses. No pip. */
  state: 'running' | 'background' | 'completed' | 'failed' | 'stopped' | 'waiting' | 'needs-you' | 'paused' | 'result-ready' | 'reviewed' | 'attention' | 'resumable' | 'stale' | 'resumed';
dtsPropsFor.Baton:
/** Who must act next. 'assistant' is the worker handoff case; 'none' renders nothing. */
  owner: 'none' | 'assistant';
